description: Categorie 1 natuurgebieden verdringingsreeks watertekort (2020) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.portaalnatuurenlandschap.nl. This historical version from 2020 of the national dataset contains the category 1 nature reserves from the displacement series water shortage. This map helped redistribute scarce water when water shortages occurred. The Water Act lays down how the scarce water must then be used. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Category 1 nature reserves displacement series water shortage (2020)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Verdringingsreeks. The listing shows 2020-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
